title: Rich text field
description: Compact comment box for table rows and other tight places. It is one line when idle and grows as the person types. When selected it shows a toolbar (bold, italic, underline, bullets, numbers and a bigger-box toggle) and it collapses again when the person moves on. A paperclip attaches images only, up to 3 MB each. Use Text box for a plain multi-line field.

props.value: Replaced the battery in Room 534 and updated the firmware.
